summary: Independent exact-head review of PR #399 requests changes. Replacing only the top-level RealizedLab.destroy capability is insufficient because the cloned external handle still publishes realized.model as a raw mutable Roblox Model. An external holder can destroy, detach, or clear that Model without the coordinated harness destroy path, leaving private current non-nil and reproducing the stale-owner lifecycle failure. The successor must expose only the minimum controlled read/diagnostic surface and add regression coverage for this alternate capability path.
evidence: PR #399 exact head 2c33c31f3ab96528308f01d18a72d2446adb1553; independent GitHub review record 4910834949.
PhysicsLabStudioHarness.bindOwnedHandle uses table.clone(realized), replaces owned.destroy, and returns table.freeze(owned), leaving owned.model equal to the raw mutable realized.model Instance.

Bootstrap currently uses lab.model only to read two attributes, while PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics consumes lab.model plus controlled RealizedLab operations; a narrower harness-owned access seam can preserve those needs without exposing uncoordinated lifecycle authority.
